notes.title: Happy New Year 2023!
notes.content:
SAD RPG Steam Early Access Update 13 
Happy New Year 2023!

[b]Added and changed:[/b]

[list]
[*] “Fix the bike” questline improved
[*] “Little Help” steam achievement added 
[*] added many graphical improvements in the city
[*] we have made minor changes to the code for future work
[*] various minor bug fixes 
[*] if you want to travel in time to Christmas and New Year 2023, use the weather station in your apartment and change the date
[/list]


[b]Happy playing and happy New Year 2023,
Evil Indie Games[/b]

notes.title: SAD RPG - The Steam Game Festival Autumn Edition 2020 DEMO
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=BcLAjqrEE9k;full][/previewyoutube]


[b]SAD RPG : A Social Anxiety Role Playing Game[/b] is an experimental indie computer RPG game about social anxiety. 
It's an unexpectedly colourful, weird and full of surprises journey with our own story about dealing with Social Anxiety Disorder.

[b]Today we release first playable demo version of SAD RPG on Steam.[/b]

[b]DISCLAIMER: [/b]Be mindful that SAD RPG is still in development so the provided demo does not fully reflect final version of the game. All things in this demo can change in the development process. 
SAD RPG DEMO contains limited content and story of the game.


[b]SAD RPG DEMO limitations:[/b]
[list]
[*] save/load system is disabled in this demo version
[*] demo contains limited portion of content from the beginning of SAD RPG game
[*] demo is based on "work in progress" version of SAD RPG, so everything may change ;)
[/list]


We are still working on [b]SAD RPG[/b] and plan to release it in Early Access in the near future. 
We are very curious about your feedback, opinions and overall reception of our game. 
You can contact us on [url=https://discord.gg/uZRQAYU]SAD RPG Discord Server[/url].



If you like the concept of [b]SAD RPG[/b] or it seems interesting to you, please add our game to your wishlist: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/857760/SAD_RPG_A_Social_Anxiety_Role_Playing_Game/

[b]Take care!

Evil Indie Games[/b]
